say:1:1320607001:1.text: What happened? Why is Callan lying on the ground?
say:1:1320607001:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜，这是怎么了，铐兰为什么倒在地上？

say:2:1320607002:1.text: Please help me! He suddenly fell and isn't moving!
say:2:1320607002:1.source_cn: 请帮帮我，他突然倒在地上，不回答我的呼唤，也不再动了！

say:3:1320607003:1.text: It's almost as if death has come again.
say:3:1320607003:1.source_cn: 就像是再一次迎来……死亡。

choice_prompt:4:1320607003.text: It's almost as if death has come again.
choice_prompt:4:1320607003.source_cn: 就像是再一次迎来……死亡。

say:5:1320607004:1.text: I'm not sure, either. My brother's body needs regular maintenance. When I went to get the oil for him, he suddenly collapsed before me.
say:5:1320607004:1.source_cn: 很抱歉，我也不清楚。哥哥的身体需要定期用蜡油保养维护，...
say:5:1320607004:1.male: I'm not sure, either. My brother's body needs regular maintenance. When I went to get the oil for him, he suddenly collapsed before me.
say:5:1320607004:1.female: I'm not sure, either. My brother's body needs regular maintenance. When I went to get the oil for him, he suddenly collapsed before me.

say:6:1320607008:1.text: Let's take a look at your brother first. Is he truly Callan? Callan Radinov?
say:6:1320607008:1.source_cn: 先看看你的哥哥吧，他是铐兰……？铐兰·拉季诺夫？

say:7:1320607009:1.text: Yes, do you know us? I'm his sister, Carolina Radinov.
say:7:1320607009:1.source_cn: 是的，您认识我们吗？我是他的妹妹，卡列琳娜·拉季诺夫。

say:8:1320607010:1.text: I'm familiar with the Radinov name.
say:8:1320607010:1.source_cn: 拉季诺夫，多么遥远的姓氏。

say:9:1320607011:1.text: Let's help him up. <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I can check on his condition.
say:9:1320607011:1.male: Let's help him up. <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I can check on his condition.
say:9:1320607011:1.female: Let's help him up. <style="stress"><player_name></style> and I can check on his condition.

say:11:1320607005:1.text: Well, our bodies will slowly decay and turn to dust. But before that, time will wear away our emotions, consciousness, and memories... Everything we knew will fade into a blurry haze.
say:11:1320607005:1.source_cn: 我们的躯体将随时间慢慢腐朽，直至化为尘土。但在那之前，...

say:12:1320607006:0.text: In losing those we cherish, we also lose the capacity for love, and gradually, our sense of self withers away. That is when death comes for us once more.
say:12:1320607006:0.source_cn: 等到失去所有所爱之人，丧失再去爱的力量，直到连自我都不...

say:13:1320607007:1.text: Greetings... Who might you be? I don't believe we've met before.
say:13:1320607007:1.source_cn: 您好……？您是哪一位？我之前没见过您。
